newsitem.title: TURKEY: TOTAL IN $20-MLN TURKISH STORAGE DEAL.
newsitem.headline: TOTAL IN $20-MLN TURKISH STORAGE DEAL.

text.p: French Total Oil will invest $20 million with a Turkish partner, Colakoglu, to build a petroleum storage and filling unit near the state Aliaga refinery, a company official said.
Ibrahim Akbal, project manager at the company's Turkey branch, said the unit wold have 18 tanks with a total storage capacity of 100,000 cubic metres.
The unit, planned to be operational by the end of the year, wuld be linked to the nearby Aliaga refinery in western Turkey run by Tupras .
"Total holds seven percent of the retail petroleum prducts market in Turkey," Akbay said.
He said 30 personnel would be employed at the unit, where 4,000 tonnes of steel sheets would be used for construction.
